landmarks.name: Galp outside Sul spectator banks and tree belt
landmarks.registration: Operator 2020 seating plan places Sul blocks outside the final right arc; direct 666/667.5 s views show stepped lower seating, a short roofed upper section and trees behind. No mapped OSM Sul footprint exists in the retained source. Eight 25 m blocks, 10 m gaps, 32 m road-edge setback and 11 rows are bounded reconstructions, with approximately 15 m positional uncertainty. Roofs cover only the first three blocks.
landmarks.ground_contract: Each bay and row follows local ground, with monotone tread heights and closed risers. Tree roots use sampled ground behind the terraces and avoid road, paved escape and mapped buildings.
